items.title: Trump and Xi conclude 'very successful' talks but no deals confirmed
items.description: There were plenty of choreographed ceremonies but no trade breakthroughs after the two-day visit.

items.title: CIA chief visits Cuba as energy crisis worsens
items.description: The reported visit to Havana came after the US renewed an offer of aid to ease the effects of its oil blockade.

items.title: New outbreak of Ebola kills 65 in eastern DR Congo
items.description: Africa's top health agency says around 246 cases have been reported.

items.title: Five Italians die during cave scuba dive in Maldives
items.description: Four of the Italians were part of a team from the University of Genoa.

items.title: Boy, 15, shot dead in France as prosecutors blame drug war
items.description: Prosecutors in Nantes say the shooting was drug-related, but the victim's aunt says he was not involved.

items.title: Australia court doubles payout for trans woman in landmark discrimination case
items.description: Roxanne Tickle has been awarded AU$40,000 in damages for being kicked off the Giggle for Girls app.

items.title: India's Adanis agree to pay $18m to settle civil fraud case in the US
items.description: The US securities regulator had accused the Adanis of paying bribes and misleading investors, which they denied.

items.title: US Supreme Court restores abortion pill access for now
items.description: Abortion pills are the most common method of terminating pregnancies in the US.

items.title: 'Pretty miraculous' - 11 rescued after pilot ditches plane in Atlantic
items.description: The survivors spent about five hours on a life raft before being rescued by the US Air Force off Florida's coast.

items.title: 'Floating armoury' ship reportedly seized by Iran
items.description: A vessel said to be a “floating armoury” in the Gulf of Oman has been seized by Iranian military personnel, according to reports.

items.title: Warning of record global temperatures as chance of very strong El Niño grows
items.description: As El Niño develops this year, scientists are increasingly confident it could be one of the strongest on record with global consequences, as Simon King explains.

items.title: Giant new dinosaur identified from fossils in Thailand
items.description: The nagatitan is the largest dinosaur found in South-East Asia and weighs as much as nine elephants.
